comments.content:
There's the [knip-reporter.yml](https://github.com/ubiquity/pay.ubq.fi/blob/dbe772fe36d7fffbe4c6ca75a3862336092c3e2d/.github/workflows/knip-reporter.yml) workflow which [posts](https://github.com/ubiquity/pay.ubq.fi/blob/dbe772fe36d7fffbe4c6ca75a3862336092c3e2d/.github/workflows/knip-reporter.yml#L27) in github PR comments a list of unused dependencies if there are any (knip comment [example](https://github.com/ubiquity/pay.ubq.fi/pull/326#issuecomment-2400662507)).
There's also [this](https://github.com/ubiquity/pay.ubq.fi/blob/dbe772fe36d7fffbe4c6ca75a3862336092c3e2d/.github/workflows/deploy.yml#L57-L112) workflow step which posts a preview deployment URL with a ready to use URL-encoded permit for ease of QAing ([example](https://github.com/ubiquity/pay.ubq.fi/pull/303#issuecomment-2350222598)).
The issue is that somehow both the knip reporter and "post preview URL" step posts in a single comment (as shown in the issue description) while the expected behavior is that knip report and preview URL should be posted in separate comments.

@gentlementlegen Help, trying to debug why permits are not created.
In cloudflare logs there's this error: 
```
HttpError: This installation has been suspended - https://docs.github.com/rest/reference/apps#create-an-installation-access-token-for-an-app
```
But https://github.com/apps/ubiquity-os seems to be properly installed in https://github.com/ubiquity.

Thank you, I'll try to update the config. There's a separate config for https://github.com/ubiquity/pay.ubq.fi since we were trying how UUSD payouts work out.
So we renamed https://github.com/ubiquibot/conversation-rewards to https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/text-conversation-rewards/ and the kernel now throws an error when calling the old https://github.com/ubiquibot/conversation-rewards although it redirects to https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/text-conversation-rewards. 
Is there a way to force the kernel to follow redirects on renaming plugin repositories?

More questions:
1. Why do we even need to modify [knip-reporter.yml](https://github.com/ubiquity/pay.ubq.fi/pull/337/files#diff-e300da0383d00d275266a83902a2aff8c7f62da696de4bc47ca5810e69c01ffe) if [deploy.yml](https://github.com/zugdev/pay.ubq.fi/blob/b0b3cf55f249ac2d9caea9815e6d44b2aee1dbfb/.github/workflows/deploy.yml) now [searches](https://github.com/zugdev/pay.ubq.fi/blob/b0b3cf55f249ac2d9caea9815e6d44b2aee1dbfb/.github/workflows/deploy.yml#L97) by comment body? 
2. I still don't understand why [this](https://github.com/ubiquity/pay.ubq.fi/pull/337/files#diff-28802fbf11c83a2eee09623fb192785e7ca92a3f40602a517c011b947a1822d3R14-R21) step is required. As far as I understand both `knip-reporter` and `deploy.yml` will always run by `github-actions[bot]` (i.e. `RUNNER_NAME = "Github Actions N"`). Why don't we need this step for all our other workflows?
The changes in `knip-reporter.yml` and `deploy.yml` should be reflected in our [template repo](https://github.com/ubiquity/ts-template) which is a base repository setup of all of the ubiquity repos so all changes must 100% reasonable because those changes will be reflected in all of our repos.
Yes, PR authors are supposed to resolve code conflicts

ok, since [this](https://github.com/zugdev/pay.ubq.fi/blob/b0b3cf55f249ac2d9caea9815e6d44b2aee1dbfb/.github/workflows/deploy.yml#L65) step (preview URL with a claimable permit) is not required for https://github.com/ubiquity/ts-template then we don't really need to update anything in https://github.com/ubiquity/ts-template and may keep these "custom" `deploy.yml` and `knip-reporter.yml` solely in `pay.ubq.fi`
